Log:
Change output of TVECm.sim and TVAR.sim: only the series

The previous output was also the parameter matrix. To avoid unecessary
outputs and be consistent with arima.sim, only the simulated series is
returned, and a new arg show.parMat=FALSE is introduced, which allow to
print the parameter matrix in case user has problems giving the args for it
